title: Capsule Types Under Capsule Typology
description: Fix sketchpad bug: capsule types do not appear under capsule typology.
summary: Capsule kinds were nested under typology-default while the Capsule typology stayed empty. Fixed rs hydration to honor typology.id refs and register typologies before nesting entities; fixed js Typology hasTypes/hasDesigns parsing; flattened MetabolismKitTypes/Designs from typologies in assets; added sketchpad DTO VFS typology tree; reconciled metabolism fixtures (capsule-representation kinds → typology-capsule); fixed architect.harness; added vitest coverage.
